5dn.text: The Kaldra avatar travels to Mirrodin's core with Glissa, Bosh and Slobad to confront Memnarch, but Memnarch seizes it with a single spell and turns it on them.
It pursues Glissa into the Tangle, destroying everything in its way, until at the Radix her body calls forth a column of green mana from Mirrodin's core that annihilates the avatar.
